title: As-far-as-a-verb-can-check-its-features theory of adverb order and scope within TP

title: Three-model architecture of automatic speech recognition (acoustic, phonetic and language models)

title: Asymdystopia: small biases raise the risk of false inferences as studies are powered to detect smaller impacts

description: The article develops asymmetry, defined as \"a lack of proportion,\" as an analytical tool for studying whether a dual language program delivers equal educational opportunity.
title: Asymmetry framework for analyzing equality in dual language programs
